subject: NexaHealth private deployment: implementation gate & on‑prem kit
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: NexaHealth private deployment: implementation gate & on‑prem kit

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. We pulled together a short preflight to make the first implementation sprint compact and low-risk. Two asks to get the ball rolling:

1) Can you confirm the infra contact we should loop in for routing/VPC peering? (we only have infra@nexahealth.com as the general alias)
2) Please confirm your preferred cutover window for the staging turnup (options below).

Attached is a draft Implementation Plan (v0.2) and a concise network requirements CSV that lists IP ranges, required ports, and preferred egress patterns. For the initial phase we recommend:
- VPC peering between NexaHealth-prod-vpc and redwood-private-us-west-2 (no shared services routing),
- Private endpoints for inference API, and
- On‑prem kit staging (edge package + 2x GPU nodes) to be validated in your staging rack.

Proposed staging windows (pick one):
- Nov 25 02:00–06:00 PST (low traffic)
- Dec 1 22:00–02:00 PST

If those look good I’ll schedule a 30‑minute technical handshake with your infra and our ops team to confirm firewall rules and the initial canary plan.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.inference
[Attachment: Nexa_Implementation_Plan_v0.2.pdf (PDF, 250KB)]
[Attachment: network-requirements.csv (CSV, 12KB)]

From: Sara Gomez <sara@nexahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nexahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NexaHealth private deployment: implementation gate & on‑prem kit

Hi Aditya —

Thanks for this. Tom (cc'd) is our infra lead and will be the best person to confirm peer and IP ranges. Nov 25 is tight for us because of a planned database patch; Dec 1 looks much safer.

Tom, can you confirm:
- Which subnet we should peer from (prod or staging),
- Any NAT or egress limitations for the peering, and
- Contact for rack access for the on‑prem kit validation.

We'll review the attachments today and circle back with comments by EOD.

Best,
Sara Gomez
Head of Platform Operations | NexaHealth
[On reply: Attached plan looked clear at a high level — will add redlines for port ranges if needed.]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Gomez <sara@nexahealth.com>, Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-19T15:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NexaHealth private deployment: implementation gate & on‑prem kit

Thanks Sara — great, Dec 1 it is. Tom, appreciate you joining.

Quick agenda for the 30m handshake I just set up (Dec 1 22:00–22:30 PST):
- 5m: Introductions and roles (who owns peering, firewall, rack access)
- 10m: Walk through the network-requirements.csv (IP ranges, CIDR, ports 443/22/50051, expected NAT behavior)
- 7m: Confirm on‑prem kit staging checklist and access (attachment: onprem-kit-checklist.xlsx)
- 8m: Go/no‑go criteria and rollout canary plan

Links: Drive copy of plan and a HubSpot deal link in thread metadata.

If anyone needs a different time we can shift by ±2 hours but would prefer to keep it during your low-traffic window.

Regards,
Aditya
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: onprem-kit-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.inference>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-20T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NexaHealth private deployment: implementation gate & on‑prem kit

Aditya —

Two internal notes before the handshake:
1) Marcus will own the peering runbook and will bring the exact iptables/NAT examples for the call.
2) Kimberly will bring the fallback policy text we use if the private endpoint DNS doesn't resolve during staging (automatic region fallthrough to hosted readonly variant).

I'll add both items to the Drive doc and flag the canary SLO gate (95th pct token latency <= 200ms for 10m).

Short and focused call will keep this low friction.

—Monica
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference

From: NexaHealth Infra <infra@nexahealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.inference>, Sara Gomez <sara@nexahealth.com>
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@nexahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference>
Date: 2026-11-24T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: NexaHealth private deployment: implementation gate & on‑prem kit

Hi all —

Confirming the staging subnet for peering: nexastg-subnet-2 (10.18.64.0/22). NAT is managed at the edge — peering will allow inbound from your redwood-private-us-west-2: 10.7.0.0/16. No egress restrictions on 443 and 22; we will need your public ASN for route filtering at the edge (please share). Rack access: contact siteops@nexahealth.com and request a staging window; they require a PO number for on‑site techs (we'll share internally).

We'll join the Dec 1 22:00 PST call.

Thanks,
NexaHealth Infra (Tom Alvarez)
[On reply: Uploaded a quick peering diagram to the Drive link.]
